title: Cash Allocation Administrator
description:
Cash Allocation Administrator

Are you a seeking a new opportunity?

We are seeking an enthusiastic and engaged individual to join the finance team to focus on cash allocation administration.

As part of this role you will be performing daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming cash using customer remittances for commercial accounts. Contacting customers via email and phone when remittances are missing or unclear, ensuring accurate allocation.

Join our client's team at The Point, Warwick Business Park and enjoy:

Fixed Term - 01/10/26 - 31/03/27 with potential for extension.

Competitive Pay: Earn £13.45 per hour, 37.5 hours per week, overtime rates of £20.18 per hour.
Shifts Monday to Friday - (minus 1 hour unpaid break)

- Daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming cash using customer remittances for commercial accounts.
- Contacting customers via email and phone when remittances are missing or unclear, ensuring accurate allocation.

- Successful candidates require a DBS check.

title: HR Administrator
description:
From Pipelines to Possibilities - Make Your Mark with Cadent

We are looking for organised, customer-focused, and detail-driven individuals to join Cadent as a People Services Administrator within the HR team.

As a People Services Administrator, you will provide key administrative support across a wide range of HR activities, acting as a first point of contact for employee queries and ensuring a high-quality, efficient service. You will play an important role in maintaining accurate HR records, supporting HR processes, and delivering excellent customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience within HR while contributing to the smooth running of a vital support function in one of the UK's leading energy networks.

How Cadent Powers Britain

Cadent is shaping the future of UK energy. With a clear roadmap to support the UK government's net zero targets by 2050, Cadent is driving innovation and creating a cleaner, greener future for over 11 million customers. Join Cadent and be part of something big.

How You'll Make an Impact

In this role, you'll support the delivery of HR services by providing high-quality administrative and customer support. Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as the first point of contact for HR queries via phone, email, and other channels
- Providing advice and guidance or signposting queries to the appropriate teams
- Supporting HR processes including onboarding, absence management, and employee records
- Maintaining accurate HR systems, databases, and employee files
- Preparing and issuing documentation such as contracts, letters, and forms
- Supporting probation reviews, exit processes, and general HR administration
- Managing shared inboxes and ensuring responses meet SLAs
- Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business
- Ensuring all tasks are completed in line with Cadent policies and procedures
- Contributing to continuous improvement and service excellence

How We'll Know You're the Right Fit

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive, and customer-focused. You'll ideally demonstrate:
- Working towards CIPD L3 or equivalent
- Experience in an administrative or customer service role
- Strong organisational skills and ability to prioritise workload
- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Confidence working with data and systems
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office
- A collaborative approach and ability to build strong working relationships
- An interest in HR (CIPD or similar is desirable but not essential)
- A proactive mindset and willingness to learn

How It All Comes Together
- Pay rate: £13.53 per hour (PAYE, paid weekly)
- Assignment duration: 26/02/2027
- Start date: ASAP
- Location: Pilot Way, Ansty Park, Coventry, West Midlands, CV7 9 JU
- Working pattern: Hybrid 2 days in the office, 3 days WFH, Monday to Friday, 37 hours per week (between 8am - 5pm)

How This Role Benefits You

Don't meet every single requirement listed? Cadent would still love to hear from you.

Cadent Gas values understanding, learning, and celebrating differences. They are an equitable and diverse employer, fostering an inclusive and accessible working environment for all.
- Recognised Disability Confident employer
- Inclusive employee communities
- Full training and on-the-job support
- Opportunity to gain HR experience within a leading UK organisation
- Free onsite parking
- Modern office facilities

How to Take the Next Step

If you're interested, please apply today with your updated CV.

A member of the Reed team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps, including a telephone interview, client interview, and pre-employment checks.

Be part of something big. Help keep Britain connected.

title: Finance Clerk / Trainee Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: Competitive, dependent on age and experience

T2 P Recruitment is recruiting for a Finance Clerk / Trainee Finance Assistant to join an established and supportive Finance team based in Kenilworth.

This is a fantastic entry-level opportunity for someone looking to begin and develop a long-term career within finance and accounts.

Previous finance experience is not essential. Our client is much more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, attention to detail and willingness to learn.

You may be a school or college leaver looking for your first career opportunity, or perhaps already working in an administration or customer service role and looking to move into finance.

The Role

Working as part of an experienced Finance team, you will receive training and gain exposure across a variety of finance and accounts activities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing, coding and posting purchase invoices
- Allocating costs accurately to the general ledger
- Investigating invoice queries and discrepancies
- Processing supplier payments
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations
- Bank reconciliations
- Managing payments into accounts receivable ledgers
- Answering incoming telephone calls
- Managing shared mailbox activity and correspondence
- General finance and administrative duties

As your knowledge and experience develop, you will also have the opportunity to become involved in month-end processes, management and compliance reporting, KPI reporting and wider Finance projects.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:
- Accurate with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communicating with colleagues and suppliers
- Proactive and willing to investigate and resolve problems
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word and Outlook
- Organised and reliable
- A positive team player
- Keen to learn and develop a career within finance

Training & Career Development

This isn't simply an administration role - there is a genuine opportunity to build a career in finance.

You will be supported by an experienced team while developing your knowledge across different areas of accounts and gaining exposure to month-end processes.

For the right person, the company is also happy to support further professional development, including AAT study support and potentially further qualifications such as ACCA as your career progresses.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity if you want an employer who is prepared to train you, invest in you and give you the opportunity to progress.

If you're bright, motivated, good with detail and serious about developing a career within finance, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and T2 P Recruitment will be in touch to discuss the opportunity with you in more detail.

- Experience managing complex content projects involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience gathering information from subject matter experts and translating it into engaging content for target audiences.
- Experience reviewing and improving content for usability, readability and accessibility.
- Exceptional written communication and copywriting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across an organisation.

- Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently, with a curious and analytical approach to understanding user needs.
- Experience of website redevelopment or digital transformation projects and familiarity with content management systems would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Pro rota holiday entitlement based on 22 days annual leave including Bank Holidays and additional closure days
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Wellbeing programme
- Onsite parking
- BUPA cash plan
- Employee assistance programme

Interviews are scheduled for week commencing 21st and 28th September 2026.

If you are looking for a creative digital content role where you can make an impact, then please apply for this Website Content Coordinator opportunity.

title: Receptionist
description: PLEASE NOTE THE HOURS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE ARE 13:30 - 18:30 Monday to Friday. We are seeking a professional and friendly Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for our patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service while managing various tasks. This role is essential in ensuring the smooth operation of our GP Practice. Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing personal requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail. Explaining practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receiving and making telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Processing prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non-General Medical Services), accept payment and issue receipts. Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying and scanning. Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Providing cover for reception / administrative colleagues during absence due to holiday or sick leave. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Signpost patients to the correct service. Input data into the patients healthcare records, as necessary. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters, and DVLA forms to the administrative team Support in the management of repeat prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently. Process repeat prescription requests received by any means of communication in accordance with practice protocol. Ensure all prescription requests are processed and are ready for collection within the required and expected timeframe. Generate requests for medication on behalf of the patient for non-repeat items. Discuss with patients their requirements, encouraging patients to order only what they require. Act upon compliance issues, liaising with the appropriate clinician. Ensure medication reviews are arranged by maintaining an accurate recall system. Effectively liaise with external services, i.e., district nurses, to ensure medicaments are arranged for housebound patients. Initiate contact with and respond to, requests from patients, team members, and external agencies. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner. Act as a chaperone as required. Be aware of your duties and responsibilities regarding current legislation and adhere to practice policies and procedures on Safeguarding Adults and Safeguarding Children Attend a formal appraisal with their manager at least every 12 months. Once a performance/training objective has been set, progress will be reviewed on a regular basis so that new objectives can be agreed. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes deemed suitable by the Practice Manager / Partners. Be an integral part of the general practice team. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying, scanning, culling of notes. Support reception staff, providing cover during staff absences. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences. Participate in local initiatives to enhance service delivery and patient care. Support the Operations Manager in reviewing and updating the Prescribing Policy and SOPs Any other duties commensurate with this position

title: GP Surgery Receptionist
description: We are looking for an experienced GP Surgery Receptionist to join our friendly team at a rapidly growing GP practice. Previous experience working in a GP surgery is essential, along with proficiency in EMIS Web and other NHS systems. The role initially offers 15-18 hours per week, with shifts scheduled between 7:45am and 6:30pm, Monday to Friday. Working days and shift patterns may vary from week to week. Additional hours may also be required to cover annual leave and sickness, so flexibility is essential. Main duties include greeting and assisting patients, answering telephone enquiries, booking and managing appointments, processing prescriptions, handling patient records and correspondence, and providing administrative support to the clinical team. The role also involves using EMIS Web and other NHS systems accurately, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring patients receive a professional and friendly service at all times. As a Receptionist within the practice, you will play a vital role in ensuring patients receive a professional, efficient, and welcoming service. You will support both clinical and administrative functions across the practice and contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of the surgery. Duties may vary in line with the needs of the service and the wider practice team. Provide a friendly and professional first point of contact for patients, visitors, and external organisations. Manage appointment bookings, cancellations, and amendments using the practice clinical system. Handle patient enquiries in person, over the telephone, and electronically, ensuring all queries are dealt with promptly and appropriately. Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records in line with NHS and practice procedures. Process patient registrations, temporary registrations, and updates to patient demographics. Scan, file, and manage clinical correspondence and patient documentation within electronic records. Support clinicians and the wider team with a range of administrative and operational tasks. Process incoming and outgoing correspondence, including emails, forms, and requests for information. Escalate safeguarding, urgent, or complex issues in accordance with practice policies and procedures. Assist with repeat prescription administration and other routine practice workflows. Promote confidentiality and ensure compliance with GDPR, NHS guidance, and practice policies at all times. Help maintain a safe, organised, and efficient reception and administrative environment. Work collaboratively with colleagues to support effective service delivery and continuity of care. Participate in mandatory training, practice meetings, appraisals, and ongoing professional development activities. Provide cover for colleagues during periods of annual leave or sickness where required. The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate flexibility, strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a busy GP practice environment.

title: MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST
description: Working in a busy GP practice. We are a close cohesive team, working hard to give our patients the best experience they can have with the GP practice. Working out of a purpose built building, a very well established GP practice in Leamington Spa. Working as part of the reception team, combination of morning shifts (starting at 7.15am to 2.00pm) and afternoon shifts (starting at 1.30pm to 6.30pm. Answering calls from patients, dealing with patients face to face. processing prescription requests, helping Drs with queries. This is a very busy, varied job role. Answering phone calls from patients booking appointments processing prescriptions Helping patients with any queries they have Helping Drs with any queries/assistance they need Busy and varied job role.
